biography: William "Will" Smith, a name now synonymous with unpredictable brilliance on the track, hails from the unassuming town of Brackley, Northamptonshire, a stone's throw from the heart of British motorsport. Unlike many of his peers, Smith's path wasn't paved with karting championships from the age of six. Instead, his passion was ignited later, at 19, while spectating at a local club race. Captivated by the raw speed and the symphony of roaring engines, he drained his savings to buy a beat-up Formula Ford car. A defining moment came during his second season in Formula Ford, where, despite starting last due to a qualifying mishap, Smith clawed his way through the field to win, showcasing the raw talent that would later define him. Currently, Smith finds himself at the peak of his career, a seasoned veteran with Caterham Supersport, constantly battling to maintain consistency and control the explosive power of his vehicle, but he's always got the speed to challenge.
drivingStyle: Smith's driving style is a captivating blend of aggression and finesse, often described as "controlled chaos." He's known for his late braking and daring overtakes, often pushing the limits of adhesion. While his tire management can be inconsistent, he possesses an uncanny ability to extract maximum performance when under pressure, frequently delivering stunning qualifying laps and race-winning moves in the closing stages. However, this aggressive style sometimes leads to costly mistakes, making him a thrilling but unpredictable competitor.

rivalries.reason: A clash of egos and contrasting driving styles. Rossi, known for his calculated approach, openly criticizes Smith's aggressive tactics, leading to several on-track incidents and heated exchanges in the media.

A fierce rivalry stemming from a controversial incident in a championship-deciding race where Smith's aggressive move forced Petrova off the track, costing her the title. Their animosity is palpable whenever they share the track.
A new rivalry, Tanaka is a young Japanese driver who joined Caterham Supersport this year. Smith and Tanaka are fighting for the place of team leader, and regularly fight on the track.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks, regardless of the weather.
Before each race, he listens to a specific song to psych himself up, a punk rock anthem from his teenage years.
Refuses to eat anything green on race weekends, believing it brings bad luck.
famousQuote: You can't win if you don't take risks. Sometimes you have to send it!
careerHighlight: Winning the Silverstone Grand Prix in 2020, in front of his home crowd, after a stunning last-lap overtake on Marco Rossi. The roar of the crowd as he crossed the finish line is a moment he'll never forget.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final race of the 2021 season while battling for the championship. The incident not only cost him the title but also shook his confidence for several months.
